# Chamuka Daybreak

> Brand infrastructure for Chamuka Labs, an applied AI lab. Tokens, React components, and logo icons for Next.js + React 19 + Tailwind apps. Not a product. Audience: business teams. Feel: playful, warm, African-rooted — not toy-like.

Chamuka Labs is an applied AI lab: we ship AI-native products, put research into practice, and build tools for AI agents.

DrawIt, FormIt, Play, Waypoint, Vmette and others are experiments or infrastructure, not launched products. DrawIt is an experiment under agent and human interaction (a canvas you and the model both edit). “From thoughts to form” is DrawIt’s line only — never the lab’s. Voice: founder-led, short, specific, slightly dry.

The GitHub repository is https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-design (formerly chamuka-branding). Apache-2.0 code; names and Daybreak marks are trademarks — see TRADEMARKS.md.

## Packages

- `@chamuka/tokens` — Daybreak v2: DTCG JSON → `--db-*` palette and roles (dark default, light "paper" via `data-theme` / `prefers-color-scheme`), deprecated shadcn/v1 aliases, Tailwind v4 `@theme inline`, v3 preset, Archivo `fonts.css`
- `@chamuka/ui` — React 19 components (Tailwind look, UI SDK behaviour): ember as the only accent with ink text, mono uppercase controls, 1px hairlines, 2px/4px radii, focus outlines, no shadows
- `@chamuka/icons` — Daybreak mark and lockups

Install from GitHub Packages (`npm.pkg.github.com`), scope `@chamuka`. Copy `.npmrc.example`. Public npm can come later.

## Design rules (Daybreak v2)

- Spec: https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-design/blob/main/brand/daybreak-v2/SPEC.md · reference: https://chamuka-labs.github.io/
- One accent: ember #E24E1B. Text on ember is ink #12100E. Small ember text on paper is #A8340E.
- Archivo condensed uppercase display, IBM Plex Sans body, IBM Plex Mono 13px uppercase labels.
- No shadows, no side/accent borders, no gradients, no pure white or black. Focus: 2px outline, #F06A3A dark / #A8340E light.
